Local modifications (minimal):
  1. CMakeLists.txt: skip enable_testing()/test/ subdir when used as
     subproject (is-subproject from get_directory_property)
  2. src/tomlf/ser.f90: removed default initializer
       type(toml_ser_config) :: config = toml_ser_config()
     to
       type(toml_ser_config) :: config
     to work around nvfortran 26.x ICE
     (size_of: deferred-size character)

Both files have .orig backups in this directory.

Copied out of the toml-f tree (2026-10-02 05:32, ecalj symmetry.json, MD/symmetry_spglib.md 4.3):
  test/compliance/json_lexer.f90  -> SRC/subroutines/tjson_lexer.f90   (unchanged)
  test/compliance/json_parser.f90 -> SRC/subroutines/tjson_parser.f90  (unchanged)
  They read a JSON file into a toml_table (json_load), so that ecalj reads its JSON side files with the
  same get_value calls as ctrlg.<sname>.toml. Same license (Apache-2.0 OR MIT), headers kept.
